claims.gist: By 2027 a large share of organizations will create formal AI governance functions
Regulatory pressure, board scrutiny and generative AI spread are driving governance formalization
Informal guidance and individual judgment will break down as AI enters core processes
Governance should help organizations move faster with confidence, not act as a brake
Leaders should inventory AI use, name an accountable executive and define core policies

thesis: By 2027 a large share of organizations will formalize AI governance with budgets, clear ownership and documented policies.
